topic: Deprecation of old code and traffic data
summary_markdown:
The conversation addressed the deprecation of old code repositories, specifically mentioning two GitHub folders that contain outdated scripts and data. It was decided that these can be removed.

A separate discussion focused on historical data regarding traffic share per frame (`select id, facility_id, facility_traffic_share from frame`). Initially used for displaying frame traffic in inventory, this data is now considered unnecessary as the current method calculates impressions directly using `device_session_agg_4`. The consensus was that focusing on impression counts rather than historical traffic shares per frame is the correct approach.
decisions: The outdated code repositories can be deleted/archived.
Historical data calculating facility traffic share per frame is no longer needed for inventory reporting.
action_items: [p1] will commit to clean up the deprecated repositories.
